deskLvStartPreviewLabel: Preview of the Overview. It shows more as the dial goes deeper.

@deskLvStartPreviewLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the small Overview picture next to the depth dial (Welcome and Settings › Advanced › Depth).

deskLvStartPreviewCaption: Your Overview in this view. Nothing stored changes between views.

@deskLvStartPreviewCaption.description: Caption under the Overview picture on Welcome (first start).

@deskLvStartPreviewCaptionShort.description: Caption under the Overview picture on the Change level page.

deskLvStartCover: Pick a stop to see the preview

@deskLvStartCover.description: Over the faded Overview picture on Welcome before a stop of the depth dial is picked.

@deskLvStartUndercoverAbout.description: Label of the info button next to the Undercover switch.

deskLvStartChangeLater: Change it any time in Settings › Advanced.

@deskLvStartChangeLater.description: Welcome, under the depth dial: where the depth can be changed later. A "What this decides" link follows it.

deskLvStartHelpShallow: Shallow · one address, no server names, no switches.

@deskLvStartHelpShallow.description: Dialog "What this decides": the line for the first stop. Shallow is the stop name.

deskLvStartHelpDeeper: Deeper · the same wallet, plus what it is doing, in plain words.

@deskLvStartHelpDeeper.description: Dialog "What this decides": the line for the second stop. Deeper is the stop name.

deskLvStartHelpDeep: Deep end · every switch, every number: today’s app.

@deskLvStartHelpDeep.description: Dialog "What this decides": the line for the third stop. Deep end is the stop name.

deskLvStartPickFirst: Pick a view first. Nothing connects until you do.

@deskLvStartPickFirst.description: Welcome, under the three doors (Create, Import, Restore) while they are disabled until a depth is picked on a fresh install.

@deskLvStartMiniWallet.description: The wallet name in the small Overview picture on the depth dial. A sample, not the user’s wallet.

@deskLvStartMiniLine.description: The one sentence under the balance in the small Overview picture at Shallow. A sample.

@deskLvStartMiniFresh.description: Balance tile in the small Overview picture at Deeper: mining rewards not yet spendable.

@deskLvStartMiniWaiting.description: Balance tile in the small Overview picture at Deeper: coins waiting for the sender to sign.

deskLvStartAdvNote: A deeper view shows more of the wallet. Nothing stored changes.

@deskLvStartAdvNote.description: Settings › Advanced at Shallow, under the Depth row.

@deskLvStartAboutDepth.description: Screen-reader text of the Depth row in Settings › About. name is the depth: Shallow, Deeper or Deep end.
